summary: OpenPGP is a message format for email and file encryption, but it lacks a standard, secure way to look up someone's public key. This experimental document specifies a DANE method that publishes OpenPGP public keys in DNS, so that a key can be located and checked using the DNSSEC-protected domain name system.

eli5.summary: To send someone a locked message you need their padlock. This lets people put their padlock on a trusted public noticeboard, the domain name system, so anyone can find the right one.
